title: system.status
description: System health and configuration status broadcast over SSE

time.description: Current server UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 format

config_status.description: Configuration health status under Last-Known-Good Configuration (LKGC)

config_error.description: Diagnostic error message when config_status is error, null when config_status is ok

providers.description: Optional health summary map of upstream data providers keyed by widget instance ID

additionalProperties.description: Operational health status of the provider ('healthy', 'degraded', 'error')
